name: BEGIN_COMMIT_BASIC
description: Plain BEGIN; INSERT; COMMIT; persists writes

name: BEGIN_ROLLBACK_DROPS_WRITES
description: BEGIN; INSERT; ROLLBACK; discards writes

name: BEGIN_DEFERRED_BASIC
description: BEGIN DEFERRED is the default mode and persists writes on COMMIT

name: BEGIN_IMMEDIATE_BASIC
description: BEGIN IMMEDIATE acquires write lock up front and persists on COMMIT

name: BEGIN_EXCLUSIVE_BASIC
description: BEGIN EXCLUSIVE acquires exclusive lock up front and persists on COMMIT

name: BEGIN_WITHIN_BEGIN_REJECTED
description: Negative: starting BEGIN while a transaction is already open is rejected
expected_stderr_contains: cannot start a transaction within a transaction

name: COMMIT_WITHOUT_TRANSACTION
description: Negative: COMMIT with no active transaction is rejected
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
COMMIT;
expected_stderr_contains: cannot commit - no transaction is active

name: ROLLBACK_WITHOUT_TRANSACTION
description: Negative: ROLLBACK with no active transaction is rejected
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
ROLLBACK;
expected_stderr_contains: cannot rollback - no transaction is active

name: SAVEPOINT_DEPTH_1_RELEASE
description: Single SAVEPOINT + RELEASE persists the staged writes

name: SAVEPOINT_DEPTH_2_RELEASE
description: Two-level SAVEPOINT + RELEASE persists both stages

name: SAVEPOINT_DEPTH_3_RELEASE
description: Three-level SAVEPOINT + RELEASE persists all stages

name: SAVEPOINT_DEPTH_4_RELEASE
description: Four-level SAVEPOINT + RELEASE persists all four stages

name: SAVEPOINT_DEPTH_5_RELEASE
description: Five-level SAVEPOINT + outer RELEASE persists all five stages

name: ROLLBACK_TO_SAVEPOINT_INNER
description: ROLLBACK TO inner savepoint discards inner stage but keeps outer stage

name: ROLLBACK_TO_SAVEPOINT_DOES_NOT_CLOSE
description: ROLLBACK TO leaves the savepoint open so it can be reused or released

name: RELEASE_UNKNOWN_SAVEPOINT_REJECTED
description: Negative: RELEASE on an unknown savepoint name is rejected
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
RELEASE missing_savepoint;

name: ROLLBACK_TO_UNKNOWN_SAVEPOINT_REJECTED
description: Negative: ROLLBACK TO an unknown savepoint name is rejected
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
ROLLBACK TO missing_savepoint;

name: TXN_SEES_OWN_WRITES
description: An active transaction sees its own uncommitted writes

name: ROLLBACK_ERASES_ALL_WRITES
description: ROLLBACK discards every write made during the transaction

name: COMMIT_AFTER_ONLY_SELECTS
description: COMMIT after a transaction containing only SELECT is a no-op

name: ROLLBACK_OF_SAVEPOINT_PRESERVES_OUTER
description: ROLLBACK TO clears only that savepoint's writes; outer writes survive

name: MULTI_PHASE_TXN_STATE_VISIBILITY
description: BEGIN -> mutation -> ROLLBACK -> BEGIN -> mutation -> COMMIT yields expected counts

name: PRAGMA_RECURSIVE_TRIGGERS_DEFAULT
description: PRAGMA recursive_triggers defaults to 0 (off)
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
PRAGMA recursive_triggers;

name: PRAGMA_RECURSIVE_TRIGGERS_ON_THEN_READ
description: Setting PRAGMA recursive_triggers=1 and reading it back returns 1

name: RECURSIVE_TRIGGERS_WITH_SAVEPOINTS
description: recursive_triggers=1 combined with nested savepoints still persists writes

name: SAVEPOINT_REUSE_AFTER_RELEASE
description: Re-using the same savepoint name after RELEASE creates a fresh savepoint

name: ROLLBACK_TO_OUTER_DROPS_INNER_WRITES
description: ROLLBACK TO an outer savepoint discards every write since that savepoint

name: BEGIN_THEN_DDL_THEN_ROLLBACK
description: DDL inside BEGIN does not auto-commit; ROLLBACK undoes both the CREATE and INSERT
